notes.title: The Shopkeeper hits v1.1!
notes.content:
We've just updated The Shopkeeper to v1.1, which focuses mainly on the cursor; making it more obvious, fixing some oddness and adding a system for knowing if youve listened to something before or not.

[B]Changelog:[/b]
- Brightened the cursors so its slightly more obvious when you hover over something clickable as opposed to not
- The eye cursor now comes in colours: Red is if youve heard something before, Green is if you havent. (Note: some items have variations on descriptions, these will be green even if youve heard one version already)
- fixed the cursor from highlighting objects even though the options or notes menu was open.

I hope this ups the enjoyment, it's just Georg and me, so updates take a while. 

[b]Stuff to expect in a next version:[/b]
- Some animations become skippable.
- The game tracks the dialogue trees youve visited completely already, highlighting the choices you havent made yet.

Enjoy and happy holidays!
Tom De Roeck

PS: In case you hadnt figured it out yet, clicking during dialogue (or monologue) skips that part.

EDIT 29/12/2014:
- Fixed a bug where you could not open the options menu on the start screen
